summary_hint: what kind of occupancy evidence (utility bill, voter registration, lease), for whom, at which service address, dated when — e.g. 'PG&E electric bill, J. Rivera, 41 Oak St, service active since 2024-03, statement 2026-06.'

typed_core.name: document_title
typed_core.why: processor — occupancy evidence spans utility/voter/lease; the title disambiguates the source class

typed_core.name: evidence_type
typed_core.why: identity — CORE; what kind of occupancy proof this is (utility/voter/insurance/lease)
typed_core.prompt_hint: Occupancy evidence is issuer-diverse (utility, voter registration card, insurance declarations, lease). Set evidence_type from the document class, not from a printed label

typed_core.name: issuer_or_provider_name
typed_core.why: identity — CORE; the utility/agency/provider that issued the evidence (independence of source)

typed_core.name: occupant_name
typed_core.why: identity — CORE; the person the evidence places at the address (borrower match)

typed_core.name: occupant_name_2
typed_core.why: identity — second named occupant on the evidence

typed_core.name: occupant_count
typed_core.why: disambiguator — how many occupants the split produced; guards a bad name split

typed_core.name: service_or_property_address
typed_core.why: identity — CORE; the address occupancy is being evidenced for (the crux of the document)

typed_core.name: mailing_address
typed_core.why: disambiguator/processor — a mailing address differing from the service address is itself an occupancy signal

typed_core.name: document_or_statement_date
typed_core.why: identity — CORE; document date, drives recency

typed_core.name: coverage_period_start
typed_core.why: processor — start of the service/coverage window the evidence spans

typed_core.name: coverage_period_end
typed_core.why: processor — end of the service/coverage window

typed_core.name: service_or_lease_start_date
typed_core.why: processor — when service/occupancy began, shows length of residence

typed_core.name: current_service_or_occupancy_status
typed_core.why: identity/processor — CORE; active vs inactive service
typed_core.prompt_hint: Do NOT infer occupancy status — extract the printed service status verbatim; the tag layer judges

typed_core.name: owner_renter_or_other_status
typed_core.why: processor — owner vs renter vs household member changes how occupancy is read

typed_core.name: household_or_residency_relationship
typed_core.why: processor — relationship of occupant to the borrower/household

typed_core.name: account_or_reference_number_masked
typed_core.why: PII — masked account/reference identifier; must be a named field, not catch-all
typed_core.prompt_hint: Never emit an unmasked account number; if only a full number is visible, mask to last-4

typed_core.name: loan_number
typed_core.why: identity — links the evidence to the loan file

rejected.name: issuer_name
rejected.reason: duplicates issuer_or_provider_name for this doc type

rejected.name: amount_due_or_paid
rejected.reason: OPTIONAL; a bill amount is not occupancy evidence and has no consumer

rejected.name: usage_or_activity_summary
rejected.reason: OPTIONAL; free text, no consumer, stays in catch-all

rejected.name: address_match_quality
rejected.reason: TECHNICAL — a conclusion, not a fact; rules judge address match

rejected.name: signature_blocks / notary_block
rejected.reason: occupancy evidence (a bill) is not an executed instrument

rejected.name: document_status_or_version, effective/expiration dates
rejected.reason: no consumer; duplicate the statement date/period

rejected.name: issuer_address / issuer_phone / issuer_email_or_url
rejected.reason: no rule; independent-verification use is speculative

rejected.name: form_number / form_revision_date
rejected.reason: occupancy evidence is not a standardized form

encoding_variations: Occupancy status appears as 'Active,' 'Current,' 'In service,' or an implicit non-zero balance — needs current_service_or_occupancy_status beside the account to be trustworthy
Service address vs mailing address: bills often print both; without both fields captured, a same-value comparison (the occupancy signal) is impossible
Coverage period may be a single 'Billing period 05/01-05/31' range or two separate dates

open_questions.q: evidence_type without a fixed enum — the catalog gives no enum_values.
open_questions.recommendation: free str now, revisit if a future occupancy rule needs a normalized value

open_questions.q: owner_renter status relevance — with zero rules its only use is processor review.

notes: No rules read this document today (rule_count 0), so there is no rule floor. Every field earns its place by identity, PII protection, disambiguation, or processor use. Field count is kept lean for a Tier-3 doc.
account_or_reference_number_masked needs _PII_FIELDS registration, pre_masked true (issuer prints only the display/last-4 form on a bill).
Occupant names and addresses are standard sensitivity in the catalog -> not registry PII, kept as identity fields.
A usage/consumption table (if present) has no consumer and stays in the catch-all.
